title: Registered Dietitian
description: PURPOSE AND SCOPE: Provides nutritional services for the facility’s in-center and home patients as applicable in order to maximize the patient’s nutritional status and improve clinical outcomes. Functions as a member of the interdisciplinary healthcare team, supporting the FMCNA commitment to the Quality Enhancement Program (QEP) and Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAI) activities. Actively participates in process improvement activities that enhance the likelihood that patients will achieve their individualized patient-specific goals as determined by the patient’s physician. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Assesses patient’s knowledge of diet and kidney disease and provides education appropriate to patient’s learning needs regarding the relationship of diet and kidney disease and the impact on the treatment process. Provides patient specific detailed education to patient/family/caregiver regarding nutritional status, adequacy measures and results, fluid status, and all nutrition related lab parameters pertaining to their disease process. Completes nutritional assessment and participates in the interdisciplinary comprehensive assessments. Participates with the interdisciplinary team in the development of a written, individualized comprehensive plan of care that specifies the services necessary to address the patient’s needs, in accordance with established Federal and, where applicable, state licensure guidelines. Calculates diet prescription according to standard of practice. Completes progress notes on all chronic dialysis patients according to established FMCNA guidelines. Maintains complete and accurate documentation of all appropriate information in medical record according to established FMCNA policies and Federal and state regulations. Provides patient with ongoing nutrition assessment and outcome-oriented nutrition counseling necessary to assist patient in achieving and sustaining an effective nutritional status. Identifies malnourished patients as well as patients at risk for malnutrition and works collaboratively with interdisciplinary team to identify appropriate interventions, resources or solutions. Reviews each patient’s albumin level and body weight at least monthly. Implements plan of care with involvement of patient/family/caregiver. Monitors adherence and response to nutrition therapy, adjusts therapy as needed to achieve and sustain an effective nutritional status, documents why the patient was unable to achieve the goals and implements the plan of care to address issues impacting the patient’s ability to achieve the goals. Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on Urea Kinetic Modeling recommendations to achieve the physician’s prescription of Kt/V. Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on management and recommendations for mineral metabolism and renal bone disease, anemia and iron status, nutritional status, psychosocial status, vascular access, modality, rehabilitation status and sodium/volume control. Adheres to FMCNA algorithm and medical record policies. Reports on nutrition QAI results and participates in the interdisciplinary QAI program. Collaborates and coordinates with team members in provision of Pre-ESRD education as appropriate. When appropriate, works with Case Manager to coordinate plan of care for patient education and identifies candidates to refer to physician for nutritional supplements, as per disease management agreements. Reviews nutrition related lab results: Counsels patient and/or caregiver and formulates appropriate action. Recommends treatment changes to the interdisciplinary team as appropriate. Communicates with physician and/or facility staff regarding lab results as appropriate. Communicates lab results and recommended treatment changes to providers of patient care in nursing facilities (i.e., hospitals, short term and long-term care facilities). Participates in pertinent staff meetings (i.e., general staff, quality improvement), Care plan meetings, and others as applicable. Consults with FMS Corporate Dietitian regarding nutrition concerns as needed. Maintains and improves knowledge and skills for a competent and innovative practice. Maintains dietetic registration and continuing education hours as specified by American Dietetic Association and state licensure regulations where applicable. Collaborates with interdisciplinary team, ensuring that all work areas are safe and clean. Other nutrition management duties as assigned. Performs other related duties as assigned. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS : The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials. Day to day work includes desk and personal computer work and interaction with patients, facility staff and physicians. The position requires travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community. Travel to regional, Business Unit and Corporate meetings may be required. SUPERVISION: None EDUCATION AND REQUIRED CREDENTIALS : Registered Dietitian as per Commission on Dietetic Registration Board Certified Specialist in Renal Nutrition encouraged. Current state licensure if applicable. EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS : Minimum of 1-year professional work experience in clinical nutrition as a Registered Dietitian. Previous renal experience preferred. Demonstrated leadership competencies and skills for the position, including ability to teach, strong organizational skills, excellent communication, customer service, relationship development, results orientation, team building and decision making. Able to perform responsibilities with minimum supervision. Basic computer skills required. The rate of pay for this position will depend on the successful candidate’s work location and qualifications, including relevant education, work experience, skills, and competencies. Annual Rate: $74,000.00 - $124,000.00 Fresenius Medical Care maintains a drug-free workplace in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. title: Master Data Management Analyst – Legacy SAP MDG Support (MM & Business Partner)
hiring_org: IN01 IND Fresenius Medical Care India Private Limited
description: Role Purpose The Master Data Management (MDM) Analyst is responsible for the operational support, execution, governance, and continuous improvement of legacy SAP Master Data processes, with primary accountability for Material Master (MM) and Business Partner (BP/Vendor/Customer) domains. The role ensures high-quality, compliant, and business-ready master data through execution of governance procedures, management of master data requests, issue resolution, workflow support, and data quality monitoring. As part of the Enterprise MDM team, the analyst will support the current legacy ERP and MDG environment while contributing to the organization's SAP S/4HANA transformation roadmap. The role requires a strong understanding of master data processes in both traditional SAP ERP environments and S/4HANA master data concepts, enabling a smooth transition from legacy support into future-state S/4 operations. Key Responsibilities Legacy Master Data Operations & Support Execute day-to-day master data maintenance and governance processes for Material Master and Business Partner data objects. Support creation, change, extension, blocking, and deactivation requests across legacy SAP environments. Monitor and manage master data workflows, approvals, escalations, and exception handling. Ensure adherence to established master data policies, standards, and governance controls. Investigate and resolve master data defects, workflow issues, replication failures, and data inconsistencies. Support ServiceNow tickets, incidents, requests, and problem management activities within established SLAs. Coordinate with AMS providers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to resolve master data issues. Material Master (MM) Support Maintain and govern material master records across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and commercial processes. Support material creation, extension, classification, and lifecycle management activities. Perform data validation and quality checks across material-related attributes and organizational views. Support integration requirements across MM, SD, PP, WM/EWM, and Finance processes. Execute mass update and data remediation activities where required. Business Partner (BP) Support Support creation and maintenance of customers, vendors, and business partner master data. Ensure accuracy of BP roles, relationships, partner functions, and organizational assignments. Perform duplicate checks, harmonization activities, and governance reviews. Support supplier and customer onboarding processes. Assist with compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements impacting business partner data. Data Quality & Governance Monitor master data quality KPIs and identify data quality risks. Execute data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and cleansing activities. Perform root cause analysis of recurring master data issues and recommend corrective actions. Partner with business data owners and stewards to improve data quality and process compliance. Support governance forums, stewardship activities, and data quality reviews. Maintain governance documentation, business rules, and process standards. Enhancement & Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve master data processes, controls, and user experience. Support implementation of enhancements and process optimization initiatives. Participate in testing, defect resolution, and release activities. Assist in documenting business requirements and translating them into actionable enhancements. Contribute to process standardization and automation initiatives. S/4HANA Transition Support Support master data readiness activities for SAP S/4HANA transformation programs. Participate in data cleansing, harmonization, and migration initiatives. Develop understanding of SAP S/4HANA Business Partner and Material Master models. Support future-state MDG and governance processes during transition from legacy systems. Assist project teams with master data validation, testing, and cutover activities. Act as a bridge between legacy operations and future-state S/4 master data processes. Key Interfaces Internal SAP COE Functional Teams SAP Data Lead / Governance Lead Business Process Owners Procurement Supply Chain & Manufacturing Teams Finance Organization Commercial Operations Data Stewards GBS Operations Teams Enterprise Architecture & Transformation Teams External AMS Service Providers SAP Support Partners System Integrators Data Management Solution Vendors Required Experience 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Management, SAP Support, or Data Governance roles. Hands-on experience supporting Material Master and/or Vendor/Customer Master processes. Experience operating within SAP ECC or legacy SAP ERP environments. Experience working in global support or shared service environments. Exposure to SAP S/4HANA projects, migrations, implementations, or support activities is highly desirable. Experience working within ITIL-based service management processes. Required Knowledge & Skills Functional Expertise Strong understanding of SAP Material Master processes. Strong understanding of Customer, Vendor, and Business Partner master data. Knowledge of master data governance principles and lifecycle management. Understanding of procurement, supply chain, logistics, and finance business processes. Experience with data quality management and issue resolution. SAP & Technical Skills Required SAP ECC Master Data SAP MM SAP Business Partner / Customer-Vendor Data SAP Workflow Processing Data Governance and Data Quality Processes ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools Advanced Excel and reporting capabilities Preferred SAP MDG-M SAP MDG-BP SAP S/4HANA Master Data Model Business Partner Conversion Concepts SAP Data Services SAP Information Steward BRF+ and Workflow knowledge Familiarity with DRF (Data Replication Framework) Behavioural Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Customer-focused support mindset Ability to manage multiple priorities and tickets Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Attention to detail and data accuracy Process-oriented and governance-focused approach Continuous improvement mindset Ability to work effectively across global teams Success Profile The ideal candidate is someone who: Can independently support legacy Material Master and Business Partner operations from Day 1. Understands governance, workflow, and data quality processes in SAP environments. Has exposure to SAP S/4HANA master data concepts and is interested in expanding into future-state S/4 support. Can help maintain operational stability today while supporting the organization's ERP modernization journey.
